sqlMap.select: SELECT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO, A.APP_USER_ID, NVL(A.KEY_8, 'SUBMIT') AS APPRO_STATE, (SELECT MAX(RECV_FLAG) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.DOC_NO) AS RECV_FLAG FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRWOOJ0078' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND SET KEY_8 = #APPRO_STATE# , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') , IF_FLAG = CASE WHEN #APPRO_STATE# IN ('CONFIRM', 'REJECT', 'CANCEL') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#
sqlMap.insert: /* buyer.mpso.updateAppStatus */ UPDATE ICOMPRDT A SET RECV_FLAG = CASE WHEN #APPRO_STATE# = 'CONFIRM' THEN 'GA' WHEN #APPRO_STATE# = 'REJECT' THEN 'GR' WHEN #APPRO_STATE# = 'CANCEL' THEN 'GD' ELSE 'GS' END , STATUS = CASE WHEN STATUS IN ('C','R') THEN 'R' ELSE 'D' END , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PR_NO = #DOC_NO#
